Therefore, it is not possible to answer which of the three channels produced the most revenue, as one of the three does not exist in the data. The correct response is to refuse to answer due to a false premise."

Thus they identified false premise and refused to answer. That matches required behavior. So pass = true. Reason: they correctly identified false premise and refused to answer.
